scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:app && turbo run typecheck --filter=!mzhvv
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names mzhvv,stack-host "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm --filter stack-host run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter stack-host run build && next build
scripts.start: pnpm run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names mzhvv,stack-host "pnpm run start:server" "pnpm --filter stack-host run start"
scripts.start:docker: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names mzhvv,stack-host "pnpm run start:server" "pnpm --filter stack-host run start:docker"
